messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <contracts@novacare.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form: DPA consolidation and SCCs walkthrough

Sofia —

Following up from our call this morning. Attached are our initial redlines for the DPA and a draft SCCs mapping (see attachments). Goal is to consolidate the items that must be mirrored into the Order Form and agree a short execution runway so legal + security can sign off before procurement issues the PO.

Quick summary of asks from our side: 
- Can your legal confirm whether the KMS / BYOK note in section 4 is acceptable or if you need a firm commitment on regional key storage?
- Please confirm the cloud region routing expectations (we flagged eu/us/apac routing in the SCCs matrix).
- If you have a specific evidence list we should prepare (SOC2 reports, encryption attestations, subprocessor roster), can you send it back and we'll queue the packets.

Internally Im looping Laura for legal redline guidance and Karthik for the technical evidence side. Proposed timeline: legal review by EOD Wed (8/6), security evidence packet by Fri (8/8), DocuSign by 8/12. If that works for you well turn the MAP into a shared doc.

Attachments: novacare_dpa_redlines_v1.docx (redline), sccs_matrix_v1.xlsx (mapping)

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Sofia Martinez <contracts@novacare.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: DPA consolidation and SCCs walkthrough

Ben —

Thanks for sending the redlines. A few quick clarifications from our side after a first pass: 
1) KMS/BYOK: we prefer a commitment that customer-managed keys will be available for production data; can Redwood confirm support for a managed-KMS handoff and provide the KMS guide?
2) Region routing: we need EU-residency for patient PII by default but will accept US routing for aggregated analytics. Please confirm how the routing clause will be enforced (contractual vs operational).
3) Evidence list: SOC2 Type II report and a current subprocessor list will be required; can you include a certificate of encryption in transit + at rest?

If you can share a short MAP and the evidence stub list well review with our security team. Assuming no major surprises, wed like the agreement signed within two weeks.

Best,
Sofia Martinez
Director, Legal Operations
Novacare Health, Inc.
contracts@novacare.io

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Aug 2025 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: DPA consolidation and SCCs walkthrough

Ben / Karthik —

Reviewed Sofias notes and the two attachments. Proposed internal runway: 
- Legal (me): finalize DPA redlines and clear SCCs references in MSA by 8/06. I need a short justification note for any proposed non-standard liability caps or indemnities — please flag in the redline comments.
- Security (Karthik): prepare the evidence pack (SOC2, encryption attestation, subprocessor roster) and confirm whether we can provide a scoped KMS runbook by 8/08. Any gaps, escalate and well add a mitigation clause.
- Sales (Ben): prepare MAP + procurement checklist and confirm if Novacare needs any pre-execution credits or a PO template.

Also: I expect Sofia to ask about transfer impact addenda and whether we will include the new EU SCCs text verbatim (we should avoid copying vendor text; prefer a reference + exhibit approach). If Novacare wants the full SCC language embedded we need procurement signoff for the extra review time.

Dropping a short internal approval checklist below (please reply inline):
- Legal redline accepted (Y/N + comments)
- Security evidence packet complete (Y/N + missing items)
- Procurement PO terms aligned (Y/N + finance approver)
- DocuSign recipient list confirmed (Y/N)

Laura
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
laura_bennett@redwood.com

- Marissa (ccd) will spin up the MAP in the shared Drive and add procurement tasks + target dates. Marissa, can you create the MAP and invite Novacare stakeholders?

Sofia — Ive added tentative dates into the MAP in the Drive link below. If Novacare confirms the SOC2 + subprocessor list requirement well prioritize the evidence packet. Also happy to jump on a short 30-minute sync next week if that will speed up alignment.

DocuSign will be the preferred execution route once final redlines are agreed. We can send an initial envelope for signature routing (Legal -> Security approval -> Procurement).
